var funcConfig = {
  calc: {
    parseSelectProduct: [{
      id: 'calculator_support_radio',
      inputs: ['calculator_support_radio'],
      function: function _function(source) {
        if (source && source.length > 0) {
          source.forEach(function (data) {
            data.inputValue = data.usageValue;
            var input = data.usageValue;
            if (data.resourceSpecCode === 'supportplan.developer') {
              input = 26;
            } else if (data.resourceSpecCode === 'supportplan.business') {
              var calcVaule = 0;
              if (input > 225000) {
                calcVaule = 9000 * 0.1 + 63000 * 0.07 + 153000 * 0.05 + (input - 225000) * 0.03;
                input = calcVaule > 90 ? calcVaule : 90;
              } else if (input > 72000 && input <= 225000) {
                calcVaule = 9000 * 0.1 + 63000 * 0.07 + (input - 72000) * 0.05;
                input = calcVaule > 90 ? calcVaule : 90;
              } else if (input > 9000 && input <= 72000) {
                calcVaule = 9000 * 0.1 + (input - 9000) * 0.07;
                input = calcVaule > 90 ? calcVaule : 90;
              } else {
                calcVaule = input * 0.1;
                input = calcVaule > 90 ? calcVaule : 90;
              }
            } else if (data.resourceSpecCode === 'supportplan.enterprise.On-Ramp') {
              var calcVaule = 0;
              calcVaule = input * 0.1;
              input = calcVaule > 5000 ? calcVaule : 5000;
            } else if (data.resourceSpecCode === 'supportplan.enterprise') {
              var calcVaule = 0;
              if (input > 900000) {
                calcVaule = 135000 * 0.1 + 315000 * 0.07 + 450000 * 0.05 + (input - 900000) * 0.03;
                input = calcVaule > 13500 ? calcVaule : 13500;
              } else if (input > 450000 && input <= 900000) {
                calcVaule = 135000 * 0.1 + 315000 * 0.07 + (input - 450000) * 0.05;
                input = calcVaule > 13500 ? calcVaule : 13500;
              } else if (input > 135000 && input <= 450000) {
                calcVaule = 135000 * 0.1 + (input - 135000) * 0.07;
                input = calcVaule > 13500 ? calcVaule : 13500;
              } else {
                calcVaule = input * 0.1;
                input = calcVaule > 13500 ? calcVaule : 13500;
              }
            }
            data.supportAmount = input;
            data.inquiryTag = 'support';
          });
        }
        return source;
      }
    }],
    buyUrls: [{
      baseUrl: 'https://console-intl.huaweicloud.com/ticket/{globalParams}#/changeSupportPlan'
    }]
  }
};
